reviews.text:
Personally I prefer the silver caution over the red one. 
Has a very light consistency very gentle coverage doesn't really work for those who have skin problems. For normal skin it works good skin looks moisturized silky and shiny. Works for at least 4 hours after needs to reply.
reviews.zh:
我自己就比較鍾意銀色嗰款多過紅色嗰款。
質地好稀好溫和，遮瑕好溫和，對有皮膚問題嘅人嚟講其實唔太啱用。正常肌用就幾好，望落保濕、絲滑、亮澤。Keep 到起碼 4 個鐘，之後就要補妝。

reviews.text: really like this cushion. It’s very long-lasting and keeps my skin matte throughout the day without looking heavy. The coverage is smooth and holds up well even after hours of wear. The only downside is that the shade runs darker compared to other cushion lines, so I’d recommend choosing a lighter color than usual.
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢款氣墊。非常持久，全日都keep住霧面妝效但唔會顯厚重。遮瑕度好滑，即使帶妝幾個小時都keep得唔錯。唯一嘅缺點係色號比起其他氣墊系列偏深，所以建議揀平時慣用再淺一啲嘅色號。

reviews.text: Out of all the tirtir cushion lines that i've tried (red and orange), THIS ONE IS MY FAVOURITE. The way it sits on my skin??? Its like a smoothing filter was applied on to me IRL. I didnt notice any oxidizing so far but im also really bad at paying attention to that so keep that in mind
reviews.zh: 喺我用過嘅所有tirtir氣墊系列入面（紅色同橙色），呢個係我最鍾意嗰款！佢貼住塊面嗰個感覺???好似現實世界幫我開咗個磨皮濾鏡咁。到目前為止我冇留意到氧化變色嘅情況，但我本身真係好唔識留意呢啲嘢，大家留意吓呢點。

reviews.text: Great color match and really lightweight on the skin. It gives a smooth, natural finish that lasts well through the day. I don’t have much else to say — it just works perfectly for me. 5 stars!
reviews.zh: 色號好夾，上臉真係好輕盈。妝效順滑自然，捱到成日都仲keep到。我冇咩其他想講——對我嚟講佢就係work得好好。五星！

reviews.text: Much prefer the silver Aura compared to the red version. Lightweight and hydrating formulation. Gives a more natural finish and easier to blend without mask effect. Great for colour and SPF touch-ups. Would recommend this to those who prefer light natural makeup, like myself. I think you can build up coverage, but I have not tested that myself.
reviews.zh: 相比紅色嗰款，銀色Aura真係好太多。配方輕盈又保濕。妝效更加自然，輕易推開，唔會有面具感。補妝同補返SPF都好方便。如果同我一樣鍾意輕透自然妝感嘅人，我會推薦呢款。遮瑕度應該可以疊加，但我自己未試過。

reviews.text: Nice concept and packaging but unfortunately doesn’t suit my skin type. The formula itself is quite nice and i like that it’s compact for use on the go. I think if I were able to test in person I’d have been able to see if it was good for my skin type.
reviews.zh: 概念同包裝都唔錯，但可惜唔啱我嘅膚質。配方本身幾好，而且夠細盒，方便帶出街用。我覺得如果可以親身試到嘅話，應該可以睇得出啱唔啱自己膚質。

reviews.text: Tip: choose a slightly darker shade! I have the 23N red, which sits well on my skin. However this one brightens the face/has a tone up effect. So the 23N was too light. But the formulaI is nice and lightweight. It's glowy and has a natural finish.
reviews.zh: 貼士：揀深少少嘅色號！我用23N紅色，喺我塊面剛剛好。但呢款有提亮／調色效果，所以23N就偏淺咗。不過配方幾好又輕盈。妝感光澤自然。

reviews.text: Yikes this did such a number on my skin after one use… I’m not sure if I’m allergic to something in this cushion or if it’s the product itself, but it broke me out so terribly after my first time trying it. I have (or had I guess) very clear skin and I’m usually not sensitive to anything - I have no problem switching products constantly (even fragrance heavy products, etc.). But this really did me dirty. I tried the product out during the day and by night my face was itching and I had red bumps forming all over. The picture is my skin the very next day. My skin is still extremely inflamed with these small bumps everywhere. This could have just happened to me but I would be careful when trying this product out and maybe do a patch test. I’m going to try not to cry and return my skin to its original condition…
reviews.zh: 天呀用咗一次就搞到我塊面咁樣……我都唔知係我對呢款氣墊入面啲咩成分敏感，定係產品本身嘅問題，但第一次用完之後就爆瘡爆得好勁。我本來（或者應該話曾經）塊面皮膚好清，我平時用咩都唔會敏感——成日換產品都冇問題（就算係香味好重嗰啲都冇事）。但呢款真係害咗我。日頭試用，夜晚塊面已經開始痕，仲生晒紅色粒粒成面都係。張相係第二朝我塊面嘅狀況。到依家塊面仲係勁紅腫，周圍都係細細粒嘅粒。可能只係我個人嘅情況，但都建議大家小心使用，最好做吓貼膚測試。我而家要努力忍住唔喊，諗下點樣可以令塊面回復原狀……

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
